parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the swimlane group.

parameters.name: IngressGatewayName
parameters.description: The name of the ASM gateway used for traffic routing. A gateway rule that has the same name as the ASM gateway is required. For ASM instances of v1.17.2.28 or later, you can specify the name of a gateway rule. The gateway rule does not need to have the same name as the ASM gateway.

parameters.name: IngressGatewayNamespace
parameters.description: The namespace of the gateway rule used to route traffic for the swimlane group. This parameter is available for ASM instances of v1.17.2.28 or later.

parameters.name: IngressType
parameters.description: The type of Ingress traffic. Only ASM gateways are supported.

parameters.name: IsPermissive
parameters.description: Specifies whether to create the swimlane in loose mode.

parameters.name: RouteHeader
parameters.description: The request header for routing traffic in a loose-mode swimlane group. This parameter is required if IsPermissive is set to true.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.

parameters.name: ServicesList
parameters.description: The services to associate with the swimlane group. The value must be a JSON array. The format for a single service is `$ClusterName/$ClusterID/$Namespace/$ServiceName`.

parameters.name: TraceHeader
parameters.description: The request header for passing through requests in a loose-mode swimlane group. This parameter is required if IsPermissive is set to true.
